label: Asbestos removal — ASB-H9 CCVS, HRCW asbestos flag

project_meta.principal_contractor: Robertson's Remedial and Painting Pty Ltd
project_meta.pcbu_name: Robertson's Remedial and Painting Pty Ltd

inference.hrcw_category: WHS Reg 2017 Sch 3 cl.4 — Disturbance of asbestos
certifications: Asbestos removal licence — Class B minimum (friable requires Class A)
permits: Asbestos removal permit — notified to SafeWork NSW 5 days prior
notifications: SafeWork NSW — 5 business days notice before removal
regulatory_notes: WHS Reg 2017 Sch 3 cl.4 — HRCW notification required
Work Health and Safety Regulation 2017 — Chapter 8 — asbestos

tasks.scope: Erect hoarding, signage and decontamination unit before removal starts
hazards: Asbestos fibre release — mesothelioma, asbestosis if inhaled
Unauthorised entry — public or workers without PPE exposed
controls: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — CCVS ASB-H9: exclusion zone established and signed off before any disturbance
Decontamination unit set up at exclusion zone entry — three-stage wet/dry/clean
hold_points: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — Supervisor confirms exclusion zone and decon unit before work starts
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: hoarding breached or decon unit not operational
🛑 STOP WORK if: wind speed causes fibre dispersal risk
admin: SafeWork NSW notified 5 business days prior

responsibility.SUP: Establish and sign off exclusion zone before work
responsibility.WKR: Follow exclusion zone procedure, use decon unit

monitoring.critical_control: Check exclusion zone integrity and decon unit operation each shift start
monitoring.evidence: Signed exclusion zone checklist on site
